name: a-pdlc-kit
description: Installs and maintains a four-level documentation discipline on a repository — AGENTS.md (how the repo is written, to the cross-vendor convention), PRODUCT.md (what the product does and why, as delivered), adr/ (structural decisions, append-only), specs/ (a feature's decisions and rejected alternatives). Use when bootstrapping documentation on an existing codebase, when building a feature whose decisions should be recorded, or when recording a decision that produces no code.
